$comment: Content-addressed integrity lock for the external Codex review. The PRIMARY integrity proof is the content hashes below, not a commit SHA and not a git tag. A commit cannot contain its own SHA (self-reference), and remote tag push is rejected by repository permissions, so neither can be required for a fresh clone to verify.
canonicalization: Only git-TRACKED files in scope are hashed; untracked files are reported by the file-set check, never silently ignored
Repo-relative paths, POSIX '/' separators, UTF-8 path encoding
Paths sorted by UTF-8 bytes, never by locale collation
Per-file value is the git blob id from 'git hash-object --path=<path> -- <path>', so gitattributes and clean filters apply exactly as Git would apply them on any platform
Text files therefore hash identically under core.autocrlf=false and =true; files marked -text or binary are NOT normalised, matching Git
No timestamps, permissions, ownership or other filesystem metadata
Per-file line '<blob-id>  <path>\n'; tree hash = sha256 of their UTF-8 concatenation
git is invoked via execFile, never a shell, so no path interpolation
implementation: reports/codex-package/hash-manifest.mjs — one implementation called by both the bash and PowerShell runners, so cross-platform parity is structural rather than asserted.
source_baseline_commit_role: Provenance / history evidence only. The product freeze point. NOT the integrity gate.
source_baseline_content_hash_role: Artifact identity evidence. THIS is the product-source gate value.
source_paths_note: Review documentation is excluded from the product-source hash by construction.
excluded_files_reason: Self-reference guard: a manifest cannot contain its own hash, and BASELINE.json carries the manifest values.
review_package_tag_note: A local tag was created as an integrity mechanism, but remote tag push was rejected by repository permissions. The gate therefore never requires it: its absence is recorded, not failed. A fresh clone verifies with content hashes alone.
handoff_history_commit_note: Latest known documentation commit at manifest creation. Provenance evidence only; superseded by the commit that carries this manifest.
reason: Documentation-only handoff and evidence refresh commits after product freeze. Product source verified byte-identical to the freeze point.

superseded_models.superseded_reason: Not portable. This repository has no .gitattributes and sets no core.autocrlf, so Git for Windows applies its default core.autocrlf=true and checks text files out with CRLF while Linux checks the same commit out with LF. Measured on the same commit: src/types.ts was 12009 bytes / 0 CRLF at autocrlf=false and 12455 bytes / 446 CRLF at autocrlf=true, and the v1 source hash differed (3da63a6b...fb56a6 vs a8debd75...9769ab). A Windows reviewer would have failed the gate on an untouched checkout.

file_set_integrity_gate: Gate 1 fails FILE_SET_MISMATCH on any tracked-but-missing file or any untracked file inside a scoped directory. Verified: an untracked file added under reports/codex-package/ does not change the package hash, so the hash alone was insufficient.

cross_platform_verification.method: Two clones of the same commit, core.autocrlf=false and core.autocrlf=true, hashed with the same v2 hasher.
cross_platform_verification.note: Verified by executing the shared Node hasher under both checkout modes on Linux. The PowerShell RUNNER itself was not executed: pwsh is unavailable in the authoring environment.

gitattributes_note: oss-integration/.gitattributes pins exactly ONE path: reports/codex-package/RUN_CODEX_REVIEW.sh text eol=lf. .gitattributes affects checkout/runtime behavior of review runners, so it is inside the review-package lock; it is NOT a self-reference exclusion because it contains no hash. Classified REVIEW_INFRASTRUCTURE_FIX, not a product capability or architecture change. Deliberately narrow: no '* text=auto', no *.ts/*.json rules (product source is frozen and the v2 canonical hash is line-ending independent), no *.ps1 rule (PowerShell reads either ending and a repo-wide rule would reach install/install.ps1, outside review scope), no *.mjs rule (Node executes CRLF scripts correctly — verified).
gate_order: file-set integrity (missing tracked / untracked in scope)
gate_order_note: File-set runs first so a deleted or smuggled file reports FILE_SET_MISMATCH by name, rather than surfacing only as an opaque hash difference. All three are hard stops with exit 4.
